query: SELECT count() AS captured_events, uniqExact(tuple(JSONExtractString(properties, 'conversation_id'),JSONExtractString(properties, 'turn_id'))) AS distinct_turns FROM events WHERE event = 'openui_turn_observed' AND JSONExtractString(properties, '$host') IN ('keating.help','chat.keating.help') AND JSONExtractString(properties, 'app_version') IN ('4.2.0','4.2.1','4.2.2') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-11 00:00:00','UTC') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-18 22:45:00','UTC')
taxonomy: Event absent from project taxonomy at query time.
